description: This file contains functions and types for installing and managing hooks in a software project, including handling npm specs, archives, directories, and validation of hook packages.

classes.name: HookInstallLogger
classes.description: Logger interface for hook installation, with optional info and warn methods.

classes.name: HookPackageManifest
classes.description: Represents the structure of a hook package's package.json, including optional hooks array and legacy keys.

classes.name: InstallHooksResult
classes.description: Result type for hook installation functions, indicating success with details or failure with an error message.

classes.name: HookNpmIntegrityDriftParams
classes.description: Parameters related to integrity drift detection for npm packages.

methods.name: loadHookInstallRuntime
methods.description: Dynamically imports the runtime module for hook installation.

methods.name: resolveHookInstallDir
methods.description: Resolves the directory path for installing a hook based on its ID and optional hooks directory.

methods.name: ensureOpenClawHooks
methods.description: Ensures the package manifest contains a valid openclaw.hooks array.

methods.name: resolveInstallTargetDir
methods.description: Resolves the target directory for installing a hook, validating the name and path safety.

methods.name: resolveAvailableHookInstallTarget
methods.description: Checks if the target directory for a hook is available for installation.

methods.name: installFromResolvedHookDir
methods.description: Installs a hook from a resolved directory, determining if it's a package or simple hook.

methods.name: resolveHookNameFromDir
methods.description: Reads the HOOK.md file in a directory to determine the hook's name.

methods.name: validateHookDir
methods.description: Validates the presence of HOOK.md and handler files in a hook directory.

methods.name: installHookPackageFromDir
methods.description: Installs a hook package from a directory, reading its manifest and dependencies.

methods.name: installHookFromDir
methods.description: Installs a single hook from a directory, validating and copying files.

methods.name: installHooksFromArchive
methods.description: Installs hooks from an archive file, extracting and processing the contents.

methods.name: installHooksFromNpmSpec
methods.description: Installs hooks from an npm package spec, handling download, validation, and extraction.

methods.name: installHooksFromPath
methods.description: Installs hooks from a local path, either directory or archive.
